summary: native-frontend-orb preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated shipped payload
details: native-frontend-orb 1.1.5 is published as a CircleCI orb for mobile frontend CI, but its preinstall hook (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into the package directory, marks it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync to run a locally-shipped math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle with `// @bun @bun-cjs` header and shuffled string-array obfuscation (WV8StW rotator, hex-numeric literal table, mangled identifiers), opaque to static reading. The advertised CI-orb purpose has no relation to a Bun runtime or a math initializer, and the alternate-runtime execution path bypasses Node-only static analysis. Installation runs the obfuscated payload under a freshly downloaded Bun binary on the installer host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
